benchmark.protocol: Two workloads; one million values per arm per sample; two warmups per arm; nine alternating-order paired samples per workload; three independent pages per engine. No concurrent build, browser stress, or native probe during the clean run.
limitations: Isolated Float64Array read/conversion/checksum cost, not Rust/Wasm transport or editor latency.
Timing depends on source shape, JIT, timer resolution and host activity; no statistical confidence interval or timing pass threshold.
Firefox common-integer page medians vary 8–19 ns, so a single scalar would hide variability.
An earlier nine-case run overlapped build/tooling work and is not used for performance conclusions.
A benchmark authoring syntax error was fixed before measurements; it was not an engine fault.
